name: gh-pr-quality-gate
description: Audit and install repository-specific pull request quality gates without granting agents merge authority.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and install safe pull request quality gates.
interface.longDescription: Inspect repository policy, install cross-agent instructions and CI templates without overwriting existing files, validate issue linkage and local checks, and prepare branch protection changes behind explicit confirmation.
